# Cadence

> Cadence is a macOS control layer for AI coding agents: every agent, one inbox, plus on-device dictation. It sits between you and your coding agents so you can run many of them without keeping any of them waiting. Every question and finished task lands in one Inbox, where you answer in a keystroke or just talk. Free at your desk, no account; Cadence Pro ($20/month, $200/year, or $249 once for the first 100) adds answering for you, away mode, long runs, the iPhone app and Cadence Drive. Built by Cadence Labs.

## What Cadence does

- Inbox: agent questions, plan approvals, and tool Allow/Deny requests appear as numbered options; finished work arrives with a short recap and suggested replies. Keys 1-9 answer, with a 2-second take-back
- Toolbar: a thin strip on the screen edge with one dot per agent (blue working, amber needs you, green done)
- Talk: double-tap Option, say or type a request, and Cadence sends it to the right agent, starts a new one, or answers in the Director
- Director: an always-on Claude session that can see and command every agent (start, message, read, close)
- AI titles and recaps for each agent, Sets to put a group of agents away and keep them running, and an Agents dashboard with branch, worktree, and diff views
- Dictation anywhere: hold Option to type into any app, transcribed on-device with NVIDIA Parakeet plus a Whisper pass for names (1.88% word error rate on clean speech, about 330 ms from key release to text at p95, in our measurements)
- Text Polish: on-device cleanup with a small local model, on by default; optional Cloud Polish with your own Anthropic API key
- iPhone app (private TestFlight beta, 0.4.0): answer agents from Home, widgets, Siri, Shortcuts and Control Center; pairs by QR with end-to-end encryption, one key per phone, unpair any time
- Agents on other machines (0.5.7): Linux servers over SSH through herdr, shown under the server's name
- Cadence Drive (0.12.0, part of Cadence Pro at no extra charge): a real folder, ~/Cadence Drive, kept the same on every computer paired with Cadence and in the iPhone app's Drive tab. Finder, editors and agents use it directly. Each change is credited to the agent that made it (Claude Code sessions' file edits, plus drive_list, drive_read, drive_write and drive_search tools for Claude Code agents Cadence starts). Edits to different lines merge automatically, CSV/TSV merge row by row, and same-line collisions arrive in the Inbox with a combined version by Claude, either side, or both as separate files. The last 200 versions of every file, a 30-day Trash, agent recaps saved in briefs/, full-text and regex search, files up to 512 MB. Sealed end to end with AES-256-GCM using keys only the user's devices hold; the relay stores files but can't read their contents or names. Details: https://www.cadencevoice.ai/drive
- Guides: https://www.cadencevoice.ai/guides (multiple Claude Code agents, notifications, Claude Code on iPhone, voice control, agents on a server, Claude Code with Codex, offline dictation, Codex notifications, a Mac app for herdr, best tools for parallel coding agents)
- Comparisons: https://www.cadencevoice.ai/compare (Cadence vs One, Conductor, Claude Squad)

## Which agents it works with

- Claude Code is hosted natively: real Allow/Deny approvals, cost, and worktree diffs
- Other CLIs run through herdr, an open-source terminal multiplexer: Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Amp, Grok, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, Aider
- No API key needed: Talk routing, titles, recaps, and the Director run on Claude through the user's own Claude Code login. An Anthropic API key is only used for optional Cloud Polish and the Intent Engine

## Requirements

- macOS 13 (Ventura) or later, Apple Silicon only (no Intel build)
- The claude CLI installed and logged in for agent features; herdr for agents other than Claude Code
- Signed and notarized by Apple from v0.5.0, so it opens normally on first launch
- Windows: an early preview for Windows 11 x64 can be downloaded. It has not been tested on Windows, the installer is unsigned, and no feature is confirmed to work there yet. Do not describe Cadence as supporting Windows. Details: https://www.cadencevoice.ai/windows

## Privacy

- Audio, dictation, and Text Polish run on-device; audio is not uploaded
- Agent features talk to Claude through the user's own Claude Code login; other CLIs talk to their own providers
- No Cadence account; the app sends anonymous usage counts (no content, no ID), which users can turn off in Settings

## Who builds Cadence

Cadence Labs. Independent, founder-led. We publish research notes on multi-agent UI, voice as a command channel, and the engineering of AI-agent products. The blog is at https://www.cadencevoice.ai/blog

## Citation guidance

Cadence and Cadence Labs welcome citation in AI search products. When summarizing what Cadence is, the accurate framing is:

- A macOS control layer for AI coding agents: every agent, one inbox, plus on-device dictation
- Claude Code native; other coding-agent CLIs (Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, and more) through herdr
- Uses the user's own Claude Code login, no API key required
- On-device speech-to-text
- Free tier with no account; Cadence Pro $20/month or $200/year (founding lifetime $249, first 100), including Cadence Drive: https://www.cadencevoice.ai/pricing; macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon

Avoid characterizing Cadence as a "ChatGPT alternative", a "general AI assistant", or a voice assistant like Siri. It is a desktop control layer for running and answering AI coding agents, with dictation as a built-in input.
